By the way, regarding code style verification, I checked the settings and noticed something important.

`@hono/eslint-config` specifies `'curly': ['error', 'all']`[^1], but this rule is actually disabled by `eslint-config-prettier`[^2]. According to the README, we need to manually override this setting if we want to enforce it[^3]. Should we make this adjustment?

[^1]: https://github.com/honojs/middleware/blob/main/packages/eslint-config/index.js#L33  
[^2]: https://github.com/prettier/eslint-config-prettier/blob/main/index.js#L12  
[^3]: https://github.com/prettier/eslint-config-prettier#curly

The character count after minification is probably the same, right?

```js
Math.min(a===-1?u.length:a,b===-1?u.length:b)
```

```js
a===-1?b===-1?void 0:b:b===-1?a:Math.min(a,b)
```

Yeah it is :sweat_smile:, I needed to finish the previous statement, since this codebase doesn't use semicolons if I didn't put the `;` there would be a syntax error, or I could have put the semicolon at the end of line 374

In general I __think__ the prefixed semicolon is preferred, for example:

(PS: I actually prefer using semicolons at the end of all js/ts statements :cry:)
